_comment: go-licence-detector allowlist used by dt3_thirdparties (Go engine). A dependency whose detected SPDX licence is not listed here fails THIRDPARTIES generation on purpose: a human must consciously vet and add the new licence (licence governance). NOTE: the underlying google/licenseclassifier emits LEGACY bare copyleft ids (AGPL-3.0, GPL-2.0/3.0, LGPL-2.0/2.1/3.0) — NOT the SPDX-canonical '-only'/'-or-later' forms — so the copyleft family is listed in BOTH spellings: the bare ids are the ones that actually match the classifier, the canonical ids document intent.
